tweets.text: 📸 More about the photograph: Body Bearers with Marine Barracks Washington carry the casket of repatriated Marine, Cpl. Thomas H. Cooper, during his funeral at Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington, Va., March 10, 2022. Cooper, 22, of Chattanooga, Tennessee, was a member of Company A, 2nd Amphibious Tractor Battalion, 2nd Marine Division, which landed against stiff Japanese resistance on the small island of Betio in the Tarawa Atoll of the Gilbert Islands during World War II, and was killed in action.
